description: This file contains utility functions for handling protection metadata in GStreamer pipelines, specifically related to encrypted media content. It includes functions to extract encryption status, key IDs, IVs, subsamples, encryption schemes, and patterns from GstBuffer metadata, and a function to process and remove such metadata from buffers.

methods.name: getEncryptedFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts the 'encrypted' boolean flag from protection metadata and updates the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getMediaKeySessionIdFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the media key session ID from protection metadata and updates the BufferProtectionMetadata object.

methods.name: getKIDFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts the key ID (KID) buffer from protection metadata and stores it as a byte vector in BufferProtectionMetadata.

methods.name: getIVFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the initialization vector (IV) buffer from protection metadata and stores it as a byte vector.

methods.name: getSubSamplesFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Parses subsample information from protection metadata, extracting clear and encrypted byte counts, and stores them as pairs in BufferProtectionMetadata.

methods.name: getInitWithLast15FromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the 'init_with_last_15' flag from protection metadata.

methods.name: getEncryptionSchemeFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Determines the encryption scheme (cipher mode) from protection metadata and sets the corresponding enum in BufferProtectionMetadata.

methods.name: getEncryptionPatternFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves encryption pattern parameters (crypt and skip blocks) from protection metadata and marks the pattern as set.

methods.name: ProcessProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Main function to process a GstBuffer, extract protection metadata if present, populate BufferProtectionMetadata, and remove the metadata from the buffer.
